title: Diverse Human Value Alignment for Large Language Models via Ethical Reasoning

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses on the SafeWorld benchmark to measure the accuracy of identifying context-specific cultural norms and taboos, and calculating a Value Alignment Score to assess how well the final response aligns with diverse cultural values.
Assessing the model's ability to deduce and adhere to region-specific legal requirements and public policies across 50 countries and 493 regions using a Norm Identification Score.
